_comment: Claude Code plugin hook wiring. MUST stay behaviourally in sync with contexer/adapters/claude.py (the console-script installer) — same code paths, same guards. Only the invocation differs: the plugin runs `uv run --directory ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` (durable plugin dir) instead of sys.executable. tests/test_plugin_hooks.py asserts this file carries no superseded anti-patterns.

hooks.command: REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -c "from contexer import store; from contexer.adapters import claude as _c; import json,sys; repo=sys.argv[1]; store.STORE_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True); store._is_sane_repo(repo) and (store.STORE_DIR/'.current_repo').write_text(repo); _c.sync_memory(repo); print(json.dumps(store.get_session_start_context(repo, store.source_from_hook_stdin(sys.stdin.read()))))" "$REPO"

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -c "from contexer.adapters import claude; import sys; claude.sync_memory(sys.argv[1])" "$REPO"; echo '{}'

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -c "from contexer.adapters import claude; import sys; claude.sync_memory(sys.argv[1])" "$REPO"; echo '{"systemMessage": "Contexer: context compaction starting — call update_context for any decisions not yet stored"}'

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -c "from contexer import store; import json,sys; print(json.dumps(store.get_post_compact_context(sys.argv[1])))" "$REPO"

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$REPO" ]; then printf '%s' "$REPO" > ~/.contexer/.current_repo; fi; FLAG="$HOME/.contexer/.pending_capture"; if [ -f "$FLAG" ]; then rm -f "$FLAG"; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "Contexer: you wrote or edited files last turn — call update_context for any unsaved decisions."}}'; else echo '{}'; fi

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -c "from contexer import store; import json,sys; print(json.dumps(store.get_bootstrap_context_prompt(sys.argv[1], store.prompt_from_hook_stdin(sys.stdin.read()))))" "$REPO"

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -c "from contexer.adapters import claude; import sys; print(claude.capture_constraint(sys.argv[1], sys.stdin.read()))" "$REPO"

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -c "from contexer.adapters import claude; import sys; print(claude.rationale(sys.argv[1], sys.stdin.read()))" "$REPO"
